test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Simple Interest received by a person in 10 years on a principal of Rs. 8500 is 180 percent of the principal. What is the annual rate of interest?
solution:
Given:

The principle = 8500

Time = 10 years

Simple interest = 180% of principal

Concept:

The simple interest = (Principle × Time × Rate)/100

Calculation:

Let's assume the rate of interest is R.

The simple interest = 8500 × (180/100)

= 85 × 180

= 15300

Now,

⇒ 15300 = (8500 × 10 × R)/100

⇒ R = 15300 / 850

⇒ R = 18%

The required rate of interest is 18%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the principal be 100.

As given the Simple interest on it for 10 will be = (100 × 180 / 100) = 180

The simple interest for one year will be

= 180 / 10 = 18

Hence, the rate% will be = S.I (for 1 year) / P × 100 = (18 / 100) × 100 = 18%
